checks.title: the effect floor is checked against the null the bar declares
checks.detail: null is floor (h0 'mean(d) <= delta'); at n=70, sd=0.784, alpha_k=0.00416667 (k=3) the test rejects above 0.5272. delta 0.28 is 0.531 of that threshold, so power at delta is alpha by construction. 50% power at 0.5272/window, 80% at 0.6061. Against a zero null the MDE would be 0.2472 (ratio 1.133), which is not the null in force.  DISAGREEMENTS: mde says 0.2243, recomputes to 0.2472; reject_if_mean_d_exceeds says 0.504, recomputes to 0.5272; next_look_alpha says 0.008333, recomputes to 0.0042; power.effect_at_50pct_power says 0.504, recomputes to 0.5272; power.effect_at_80pct_power says 0.583, recomputes to 0.6061
